The faculty and research staff of the Institute prepared a number of research papers and project reports during the academic year.
The Institute conducts research programme using its own resources and also through external funding. The externally funded projects are usually initiated at the request of the concerned agencies.
IIPS has a well-established publication unit. Periodically, it publishes Newsletters, Research Briefs and Working papers from the faculty members and other subject experts/scholars in related areas.
